services.desc: Taste is the perfect location for an intimate private dinner or private cooking demonstrations for small groups. Taste has an open kitchen with room for 12-person demonstration or a 26-person private dining. The intimate venue provides a platform for learning, experimentation, menu tastings and private dining experiences focused on celebrating the craft of cooking, drinking, and gathering at the table. Menus are customized with the freshest ingredients being locally sourced and constantly changing.
